Hi Erik! Regarding SLOTPLAN-107, the design review agreed that day names should be matched case-insensitively and full English names are accepted (e.g., 'monday', 'SAT', 'Sunday'), but abbreviations like 'Tues' or 'Mo' are rejected.

Hi @arjun, from the design review I attended: a meeting ending after midnight (end > 1440) gets a "+1" suffix on its end time, e.g. "23:00-01:00+1 Release (2h)". A meeting ending exactly at 1440 has no suffix. That's all I have for format_agenda edge cases.

Hi Mei, yes! The design review decided: room names from the free-text booking form are compared case-insensitively and ignoring leading/trailing spaces. So "Atlas", "atlas " and " ATLAS" are the same room. Hope that helps!

Thanks Priya! For format_duration: design review agreed whole hours drop minutes entirely - 120 renders as '2h', 60 as '1h', never '2h 00m'. For parse_shift: the current code matches full names or 3-letter abbreviations (full[:3]). That means 'Tues' and 'Mo' are already rejected. Does that match your notes? I'll run acceptance checks soon to verify.

Hi @noor, sure! From the design review for expand_weekly: A dropped occurrence still uses up one of the `count` occurrences (same as an excluded date in a calendar series with fixed count), so the result can be shorter than `count`; the series is not extended to make up for it.
